## Proxy used, if any

If your question didn't have a direct data field (most strategic and
leadership questions don't), name the proxy and say what it misses. If you
didn't need one, write "none".

## What works / what doesn't

Be honest — an unfinished notebook with a clear problem statement is a
complete workshop outcome. "The WASM export fails" is useful information,
not a confession.
